about_the_game:
Challenge time and gravity in an epic race for glory!

Academy: Become a Hero is an exciting 2.5D platformer where you must complete challenging circuits before the countdown ends. Master unique abilities, overcome the course, and strive to become the next hero humanity needs.

Key Features

  • Time-based races: Beat each circuit before time runs out. The pressure is on!

  • Challenging platforms: Jump, run, and use special abilities to overcome obstacles.

  • Unique abilities: Master the double jump, dash, wall jump, and other skills inspired by classics like Castlevania and Hollow Knight.

  • Immersive story: Uncover your character's story at the Hero Academy as you progress through the game.

  • 2.5D art style: Immerse yourself in a visually appealing world with 3D graphics and a dynamic camera perspective.

  • Processor: 2,3 - 2,69 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 3 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
